about_the_game:
Send your hero off on an adventure with fitting background tracks thanks to the Bit by Bit Sound - 16 Bit Fantasy Music 2 pack! Bit by Bit Sound is back with another music pack containing 15 BGMs to add a nostalgic vibe to your maps and cutscenes. Inspired by the music of the SNES, each track is ready to turn a farm map into a cozy starting point for your farmhand-turned-hero, a village into a pillaged ruin, and an old mine into the creepy home of a monstrous lich!

Give your game’s first village a calm music track while your players are introduced to your game world with “Farm Boy” and its relaxed beat, at least until the village is attacked! Fight back against enemies while “The Big Bad Revealed” plays its heavy drum beats and organ music, and let your heroes slowly take in the horrors of their destroyed village while the somber piano and flutes of “Dire Times” plays in the background. Want to take a break from the serious discussions and battles, and just let your party members laugh and bicker? Then give them a silly cutscene where “Silly Sidekicks” plays its quirky melody and brass horns toot along. Or keep a side quest where your heroes have to explore an abandoned mansion from being too spooky with the track “You Didn’t Tell Me This Place was Haunted” playing its upbeat tunes.

Each track comes in M4a, Ogg, and Wav file formats, so you can easily add them to your favorite engine. Pick up the Bit by Bit Sound - 16 Bit Fantasy Music 2 pack and help your players fully immerse themselves in your game with carefully crafted music tracks!


Contents:

* 15 BGM tracks
* Royalty free music for your games!
* m4a, ogg, wav file formats included


Terms of Use:

This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
OK to be used in Commercial projects
Contents can be edited
OK for use in games with gore
* NOT ok for use in adult-rated games *
